description: This Dart source file defines the `NetworkRepository` class, which provides an abstraction layer for network operations including REST API calls and WebSocket interactions related to user profiles, game lobbies, matchmaking, and real-time communication within a Flutter-based mobile game application.

classes.name: NetworkRepository
classes.description: A repository class facilitating network operations related to user profile retrieval, lobby management, matchmaking, and WebSocket communication for a Flutter mobile game app.

methods.name: fetchProfile
methods.description: Fetches the current user's profile data via GET request.

methods.name: fetchLobbies
methods.description: Retrieves a list of available lobbies, with fallback to mock data if the API call fails.

methods.name: createLobby
methods.description: Creates a new lobby with a specified name, returning mock data if API is unavailable.

methods.name: joinLobby
methods.description: Joins or subscribes to a lobby over WebSocket.

methods.name: requestQuickMatch
methods.description: Requests a quick match, returning mock data if the API call fails.

methods.name: connectRealtime
methods.description: Establishes a WebSocket connection for real-time communication.

methods.name: disconnectRealtime
methods.description: Disconnects from the WebSocket real-time communication.

methods.name: realtimeMessages
methods.description: Provides a stream of decoded real-time messages from WebSocket.

methods.name: realtimeConnectionStates
methods.description: Streams connection state changes of the WebSocket.

methods.name: realtimeConnectionState
methods.description: Returns the current WebSocket connection state.

methods.name: subscribeToMatch
methods.description: Subscribes to a specific match channel over WebSocket.

methods.name: unsubscribeFromMatch
methods.description: Unsubscribes from a specific match channel over WebSocket.
